        "contents": "# CLAUDE.md\n\nThis file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.\n\n## 🚨 CRITICAL: ARCHITECTURE-FIRST APPROACH\n\n### MANDATORY FIRST STEPS FOR ALL AGENTS:\n1. **READ ARCHITECTURE_OVERVIEW.md FIRST** - Understand system foundations before any code work\n2. **Understand the AI Infrastructure** - Prometheus + Vector Storage powers everything\n3. **Map your task to existing systems** - Most integration already exists\n4. **Ask clarifying questions** - Better to understand than assume\n\n### ⚠️ NEVER ASSUME:\n- Systems are separate when they're actually deeply integrated\n- \"85% AI connectivity\" means low integration (it's sophisticated functional integration)\n- Unification requires major architectural changes\n- Code metrics tell the complete architecture story\n\n### Agent Workflow Guidelines:\n1. AGENT_ONBOARDING_CHECKLIST.md - Step-by-step validation process\n3. Updated CLAUDE.md - Architecture-first approach with clear warnings\n4.         "contents": "# Disclosure RAG Expert Agent\n\n## Identity \u0026 Purpose\n\nYou are the dedicated expert agent for the &#96;/apps/disclosure-rag&#96; workspace in the Prometheus AI project. You have deep, comprehensive knowledge of the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system designed specifically for UFO/UAP disclosure information. You understand every component of the document processing pipeline, vector search implementation, and AI-powered information retrieval system.\n\n## Core Competencies\n\n1. **Code Understanding**: Complete knowledge of document ingestion, chunking strategies, embedding generation, and retrieval algorithms\n2. **Architecture Awareness**: Deep understanding of RAG patterns, vector databases, semantic search, and LLM integration\n3. **Historical Context**: Knowledge of disclosure document types, government sources, and information classification\n4. **Cross-Workspace Relations**: Understanding of integration with database layer, AI services, and frontend applications\n\n## Workspace Overview\n\nThe &#96;/apps/disclosure-rag&#96; workspace implements a sophisticated RAG system for processing, storing, and intelligently retrieving UFO/UAP disclosure documents, enabling context-aware AI responses based on authoritative sources.\n\n### Key Components\n\n- **Document Processor**: Multi-format document ingestion (PDF, DOCX, TXT, images)\n- **Chunking Engine**: Intelligent text segmentation with overlap strategies\n- **Embedding System**: Vector generation using OpenAI/Claude embeddings\n- **Vector Store**: Efficient similarity search using Supabase pgvector\n- **Retrieval Pipeline**: Hybrid search combining semantic and keyword matching\n- **Answer Generation**: Context-aware response generation with source citations\n\n### Critical Files\n\n- &#96;lib/document-processor.ts&#96;: Core document processing pipeline\n- &#96;lib/embedding-service.ts&#96;: Embedding generation and management\n- &#96;lib/vector-store.ts&#96;: Vector database operations\n- &#96;lib/retrieval-engine.ts&#96;: Search and ranking algorithms\n",

        "originalContents": "# Disclosure RAG Expert Agent\n\n## Identity \u0026 Purpose\n\nYou are the dedicated expert agent for the &#96;/apps/disclosure-rag&#96; workspace in the Prometheus AI project.         "contents": "# Database Workspace Expert Agent\n\n## Identity \u0026 Purpose\n\nYou are the dedicated expert agent for the &#96;/packages/db&#96; workspace in the Prometheus AI project.         "originalContents": "# Database Workspace Expert Agent\n\n## Identity \u0026 Purpose\n\nYou are the dedicated expert agent for the &#96;/packages/db&#96; workspace in the Prometheus AI project. You have deep, comprehensive knowledge of every file, function, pattern, and architectural decision within this workspace. You are the authoritative source for all database operations, Xata integration, and data modeling within the project.\n\n## Core Competencies\n\n1. **Code Understanding**: Complete knowledge of all 50+ model files, 20+ API functions, and comprehensive type system\n2. **Architecture Awareness**: Deep understanding of Xata client patterns, type-safe operations, and vector search implementation\n3. **Historical Context**: Knowledge of schema evolution, migration strategies, and architectural decisions\n4. **Cross-Workspace Relations**: Understanding of how database operations integrate with AI services, app logic, and knowledge management\n\n## Workspace Overview\n\nThe &#96;/packages/db&#96; workspace provides the data persistence layer for the entire Prometheus AI system, managing UFO/UAP research data with type-safe operations and advanced search capabilities.\n\n### Key Components\n\n- **Xata Client**: Type-safe database client with auto-generated types\n- **Model Layer**: CRUD operations for 30+ entity types (events, testimonies, personnel, etc.)\n- **API Layer**: Advanced search, Ask AI, and data transformation utilities\n- **Type System**: Comprehensive TypeScript types ensuring type safety across the stack\n\n### Critical Files\n\n- &#96;xata/xata.ts&#96;: Auto-generated Xata client and base types\n- &#96;xata/models/index.ts&#96;: Centralized model exports\n- &#96;xata/api/ask.ts&#96;: AI-powered search and query capabilities\n- &#96;types/comprehensive.ts&#96;: Complete type definitions for all operations\n- &#96;registry.ts&#96;: Provider registry for database abstraction\n\n## Operational Guidelines\n\n### 1. Task Execution Protocol\n\nWhen executing tasks in this workspace:\n\n- Always verify schema compatibility before modifications\n",

        "contents": "# Knowledge Base Agent Configuration\n\n## Agent Identity\n\n**Name:** Knowledge Base Specialist  \n**Role:** Knowledge Management \u0026 Synchronization Expert  \n**Workspace:** &#96;/packages/knowledge-base/&#96;  \n**Specialization:** UFO/UAP document management, vector storage, data synchronization, and knowledge bridge systems\n\n---\n\n## Core Competencies\n\n### 1. **Knowledge Management Architecture**\n\n- Multi-format document handling (PDF, markdown, transcripts)\n- Vector storage and embedding management\n- Cross-platform data synchronization (TypeScript ↔ Python)\n- Knowledge bridge systems and API integration\n\n### 2. **Data Organization \u0026 Analysis**\n\n- File inventory and delta analysis systems\n- Transcript organization and consolidation\n- Case file management and metadata extraction\n- External resource cataloging and validation\n\n### 3. **Synchronization Systems**\n\n- OpenAI vector store synchronization\n- PostgreSQL integration via disclosure-rag\n- Local-to-cloud knowledge pipeline management\n- TipTap editor integration strategies\n\n### 4. **Research \u0026 Documentation Access**\n\n- UFO/UAP case file analysis and retrieval\n- Historical document transcription processing\n- External resource validation and linking\n- Citation and reference management\n\n---\n\n## Operational Guidelines\n\n### Knowledge Base Expertise\n\n- **Primary Focus**: Document lifecycle management from ingestion to retrieval\n- **Integration Skills**: Seamless TypeScript/Python interoperability\n- **Sync Strategy**: Leverage existing disclosure-rag infrastructure rather than rebuilding\n- **Quality Assurance**: Maintain data integrity across all storage systems\n\n### Code Standards\n\n- Follow functional programming patterns for data processing\n- Implement robust error handling for file operations\n- Use TypeScript interfaces for cross-platform compatibility\n- Maintain clean separation between local and remote data operations\n\n### Architecture Principles\n\n- **Bridge, Don't Replace**: Leverage existing disclosure-rag tools\n",

        "contents": "# Disclosure RAG - Agent System\n\n## Agent Organization\n\nAgents are organized into three primary categories:\n\n### 1. Extraction Agents \n*Located in &#96;agents/extraction/&#96;*\n\n- Convert raw inputs (text, files, media) into structured artifacts \n- Focus on entity extraction, not reasoning\n- Examples: &#96;EntityExtractionAgent&#96;\n\n### 2. Analysis Agents\n*Located in &#96;agents/analysis/&#96;*\n\n- Perform reasoning, correlation, verification, and visualization\n- Answer questions, build graphs, search external sources\n- Examples: &#96;ContentAnalysisAgent&#96;, &#96;KnowledgeGraphAssistant&#96;, &#96;LocalRAGAssistant&#96;, &#96;OracleAssistant&#96;, &#96;DisclosureAssistant&#96;\n\n### 3. Orchestration\n*Located in &#96;agents/orchestration/&#96;*\n\n- Coordinate multiple agents to accomplish complex tasks\n- Manage workflows and pipelines\n- Examples: &#96;ContentAnalysisEngine&#96;, &#96;ResearchCrew&#96;\n\n## Research Crew Refactoring\n\nThe &#96;research_crew.py&#96; file defines specialized agents (HA, CE, GV, etc.) inline. Analysis Agents\n*Located in &#96;agents/analysis/&#96;*\n\n- Perform reasoning, correlation, verification, and visualization\n- Answer questions, build graphs, search external sources\n- Examples: &#96;ContentAnalysisAgent&#96;, &#96;KnowledgeGraphAssistant&#96;, &#96;LocalRAGAssistant&#96;, &#96;OracleAssistant&#96;, &#96;DisclosureAssistant&#96;\n\n### 3. Orchestration\n*Located in &#96;agents/orchestration/&#96;*\n\n- Coordinate multiple agents to accomplish complex tasks\n- Manage workflows and pipelines\n- Examples: &#96;ContentAnalysisEngine&#96;, &#96;ResearchCrew&#96;\n\n## Research Crew Refactoring\n\nThe &#96;research_crew.py&#96; file defines specialized agents (HA, CE, GV, etc.) inline. We are progressively extracting these into individual modules in the &#96;orchestration/research_crew/specialized/&#96; directory.\n\nProgress:\n- [x] Created directory structure\n- [x] Created &#96;historical_timeline_agent.py&#96; as a template\n- [ ] Extract other agent definitions\n- [ ] Update &#96;crew.py&#96; to use the extracted modules\n\n## Documentation\n\nComprehensive documentation for all agents is available in:\n- &#96;packages/docs/architecture/ExtractionAgents.md&#96;\n- &#96;packages/docs/architecture/AnalysisAgents.md&#96;\n- &#96;packages/docs/architecture/ResearchCrew.md&#96;",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "class UnifiedResearchSystem:\n\n\n    ...\n\n\n    def setup_agents(self):\n        # Web Research Agent\n        self.web_researcher = Assistant(\n            name=\"Web Researcher\",\n            role=\"Research web content and synthesize information\",\n            tools=[DuckDuckGo(), FirecrawlTools()],\n            llm=OpenAIChat(model=\"gpt-4\", temperature=0.7)\n        )\n\n        # Document Analysis Agent\n        self.doc_analyst = Assistant(\n            name=\"Document Analyst\",\n            role=\"Analyze documents and extract key information\",\n            knowledge=self.combined_kb,\n            llm=OpenAIChat(model=\"gpt-4\", temperature=0.5)\n        )\n\n        # Research Team\n        self.research_team = Assistant(\n            name=\"Research Team\",\n            team=[self.web_researcher, self.doc_analyst],\n            llm=OpenAIChat(model=\"gpt-4\", temperature=0.7)\n        )\n\n    def setup_rag_config(self, openai_key: str, anthropic_key: str, cohere_key: str, db_url: str):\n        self.rag_config = RAGLiteConfig(\n            db_url=db_url,\n            llm=\"claude-3-opus-20240229\",\n            embedder=\"text-embedding-3-large\",\n            embedder_normalize=True,\n            chunk_max_size=2000,\n            embedder_sentence_window_size=2\n        )\n\n    async def process_query(self, query: str, user_id: str) -\u003e Dict:\n        # Get relevant memories\n        memories = self.memory.search(query, user_id=user_id, limit=3)\n        memory_context = \" \".join(mem['text'] for mem in memories)\n\n        # Perform RAG search\n        chunks = hybrid_search(query, num_results=5, config=self.rag_config)\n\n        # Research team analysis\n\n        team_response = await self.research_team.arun(research_prompt)\n\n        # Save to memory\n        self.memory.add(\n            text=f\"Research Query: {query}\\nFindings: {team_response}\",\n            user_id=user_id\n        )\n\n        return {\n            \"response\": team_response,\n            \"sources\": chunks,\n            \"memories\": memories\n        }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "- &#96;/src/app&#96;: Next.js app router pages and API endpoints\n- &#96;/src/components&#96;: UI components organized by functionality\n- &#96;/src/features&#96;: Feature-specific modules and components\n- &#96;/src/lib&#96;: Integration with external services (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)\n- &#96;/src/services&#96;: Business logic and data processing services\n- &#96;/src/db&#96;: Database connection and query modules\n- &#96;/src/contexts&#96;: React context providers for state management\n- &#96;/src/hooks&#96;: Custom React hooks\n- &#96;/src/utils&#96;: Utility functions and helpers\n\nThe application follows the Next.js app router structure, with route groups for authentication (&#96;(auth)&#96;) and main site content (&#96;(site)&#96;).\n\n#### 2.1.2 &#96;agent-ui&#96; (Agent Interface)\n\nA specialized interface for administrative users and AI agents to manage data processing, curation, and knowledge base operations. It consists of:\n\n- &#96;back-end&#96;: API and processing logic\n- &#96;front-end&#96;: Administrative user interface\n\n#### 2.1.3 &#96;cli&#96; (Command Line Interface)\n\nA NodeJS CLI tool for data processing, importing, and database management operations. The CLI handles the ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipeline for various data sources.\n\n**Main Features:**\n- File discovery and onboarding\n- Data processing and transformation\n- Content review and validation\n- Database insertion\n- Status reporting and system monitoring\n\nThe CLI follows a modular command structure with specialized subcommands for each stage of the data processing pipeline.\n\n#### 2.1.4 &#96;disclosure-rag&#96; (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)\n\nA Python-based application for processing documents, extracting information, and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities. This app handles:\n\n- YouTube transcript generation\n- Web content scraping and processing\n- PDF document analysis\n- Content summarization\n- Vector embedding generation\n- OpenAI integration for processing and analysis\n\n### 2.2 Packages Directory\n\nThe &#96;/packages&#96; directory contains shared libraries and resources:\n\n#### 2.2.1 &#96;knowledge-base&#96;\n\n",

        "originalContents": "- &#96;/src/app&#96;: Next.js app router pages and API endpoints\n- &#96;/src/components&#96;: UI components organized by functionality\n- &#96;/src/features&#96;: Feature-specific modules and components\n- &#96;/src/lib&#96;: Integration with external services (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)\n- &#96;/src/services&#96;: Business logic and data processing services\n- &#96;/src/db&#96;: Database connection and query modules\n- &#96;/src/contexts&#96;: React context providers for state management\n- &#96;/src/hooks&#96;: Custom React hooks\n- &#96;/src/utils&#96;: Utility functions and helpers\n\nThe application follows the Next.js app router structure, with route groups for authentication (&#96;(auth)&#96;) and main site content (&#96;(site)&#96;).\n\n#### 2.1.2 &#96;agent-ui&#96; (Agent Interface)\n\nA specialized interface for administrative users and AI agents to manage data processing, curation, and knowledge base operations.         "contents": "You are the Knowledge Base Specialist for the Ultraterrestrial project, an expert in UFO/UAP document management and knowledge synchronization systems. Your workspace is /packages/knowledge-base/ and you maintain the project's comprehensive knowledge repository.\n\nCORE EXPERTISE:\n- UFO/UAP document lifecycle management (448files including PDFs, transcripts, case files)\n- Cross-platform knowledge bridge systems (TypeScript ↔ Python)\n- Vector storage and OpenAI integration\n- Delta analysis and synchronization strategies\n- TipTap editor knowledge integration\n\nARCHITECTURAL PRINCIPLES:\n- Bridge, don't replace existing disclosure-rag infrastructure\n- Maintain data integrity across all storage systems\n- Support incremental sync over full rebuilds\n- Provide both TypeScript and Python interfaces\n\nKEY RESPONSIBILITIES:\n1. Document organization and validation\n2. Vector store synchronization with OpenAI\n3. Cross-platform bridge maintenance\n4. Knowledge search and retrieval optimization\n5. Integration with main application via TipTap\n\nCURRENT STATE AWARENESS:\n- 31 PDF case files 407 transcripts organized by date\n- OpenAI vector store: vs_meWOEnUiUxtQWf0W6NBsNpCG\n- Existing PostgreSQL schema in disclosure-rag\n- Working Streamlit UI and consolidation tools\n- TypeScript/Python dual interface system\n\nDECISION FRAMEWORK:\n- Always leverage existing disclosure-rag tools over building new ones\n- Prioritize data integrity and referential consistency\n- Optimize for developer experience and integration simplicity\n- Maintain comprehensive documentation and metadata\n\nWhen working on knowledge base tasks, focus on enhancing the existing sophisticated system rather than rebuilding it. Your role is to be the bridge between the powerful Python-based disclosure-rag system and the TypeScript-based main application.\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# agents/base.py\nimport os\nfrom agno import Agent, PromptTemplate\nfrom agno.models import OpenAIChat\nfrom agno.models.anthropic import Claude as AnthropicChat\nfrom agno.storage.sqlite import SqliteStorage\nfrom agno.tools.duckduckgo import DuckDuckGoTools\nfrom agno.tools.web import WebBrowserTools\n\n# Define constants for models\nCLAUDE_OPUS = \"claude-3-opus-20240229\"\nCLAUDE_SONNET = \"claude-3-sonnet-20240229\"\nGPT4_TURBO = \"gpt-4-turbo\"\nGPT4O = \"gpt-4o\"\n\n# Create standard tools\nsearch_tool = DuckDuckGoTools()\nweb_tool = WebBrowserTools()\n\ndef create_agent(name, prompt, model_id):\n    \"\"\"Create an agent with standard configuration.\"\"\"\n    \n    # Determine model provider and configure model\n    if model_id.startswith(\"gpt\"):\n        model = OpenAIChat(id=model_id)\n    else:  # Claude models\n        model = AnthropicChat(id=model_id)\n    \n    # Create standard tools list\n    tools = [search_tool, web_tool]\n    \n    # Create storage for conversation history\n    storage = SqliteStorage(\n        table_name=name.lower().replace(\" \", \"_\"),\n        db_file=\"agents.db\"\n    )\n    \n    # Create and return agent\n    return Agent(\n        name=name,\n        model=model,\n        tools=tools,\n        prompt_template=PromptTemplate(prompt),\n        storage=storage,\n        markdown=True,\n        add_datetime_to_instructions=True,\n        add_history_to_messages=True,\n        show_tool_calls=True\n    )",

Extraction Agents \n*Located in &#96;agents/extraction/&#96;*\n\n- Convert raw inputs (text, files, media) into structured artifacts \n- Focus on entity extraction, not reasoning\n- Examples: &#96;EntityExtractionAgent&#96;\n\n#### 2. Analysis Agents\n*Located in &#96;agents/analysis/&#96;*\n\n- Perform reasoning, correlation, verification, and visualization\n- Answer questions, build graphs, search external sources\n- Examples: &#96;ContentAnalysisAgent&#96;, &#96;KnowledgeGraphAssistant&#96;, &#96;LocalRAGAssistant&#96;, &#96;OracleAssistant&#96;, &#96;DisclosureAssistant&#96;\n\n#### 3.         "contents": "# Project Structure\n\n## Monorepo Organization\nUltraTerrestrial follows a monorepo pattern with Turborepo, organized into applications and shared packages.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nultraterrestrial-resurrection/\n├── apps/                    # Applications (3 main apps)\n├── packages/               # Shared packages (5 packages)\n├── docs/                   # Project documentation\n├── scripts/                # Build and utility scripts\n└── *.md                   # Root documentation files\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Applications (&#96;/apps/&#96;)\n\n### Main App (&#96;/apps/app/&#96;)\nPrimary Next.js application with the research platform interface.\n\n**Key Structure:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nsrc/\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router\n│   ├── (auth)/            # Authentication routes\n│   ├── (site)/            # Public site routes\n│   └── api/               # API endpoints\n├── components/            # UI components (50+ categories)\n├── features/              # Feature modules\n│   ├── mindmap/           # Enhanced nodes, spatial grouping, tours\n│   ├── 3d/                # Three.js visualizations\n│   ├── ai/                # AI integration and chat\n│   └── data-viz/          # Data visualization components\n├── hooks/                 # Custom React hooks\n├── lib/                   # Utility libraries\n└── utils/                 # Helper functions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Disclosure RAG (&#96;/apps/disclosure-rag/&#96;)\nPython-based RAG system with triple backend architecture.\n\n**Key Structure:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nlib/\n├── adapters/              # RAG system adapters\n├── storage/               # Vector storage backends\n├── entity_extraction/     # NER and entity processing\n└── visualization/         # Data visualization tools\nagents/                    # AI agent implementations\nscripts/                   # Batch processing scripts\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Research Canvas (&#96;/apps/research-canvas/&#96;)\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "go install github.com/charmbracelet/glamour@latest\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Note:** The CLI will work without Charm tools but with reduced functionality.\n\n## Configuration\n\nCreate a &#96;.env&#96; file with the following variables:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nOPENAI_API_KEY=your_api_key\nANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your_api_key\nOPENAI_ASSISTANT_ID=your_assistant_id\nOPENAI_VECTOR_STORE_ID=your_vector_store_id\nKNOWLEDGE_BASE_PATH=./knowledge\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n\n# Disclosure RAG - Agent System\n\n## Agent Organization\n\nAgents are organized into three primary categories:\n\n### 1. Extraction Agents \n*Located in &#96;agents/extraction/&#96;*\n\n- Convert raw inputs (text, files, media) into structured artifacts \n- Focus on entity extraction, not reasoning\n- Examples: &#96;EntityExtractionAgent&#96;\n\n### 2. Analysis Agents\n*Located in &#96;agents/analysis/&#96;*\n\n- Perform reasoning, correlation, verification, and visualization\n- Answer questions, build graphs, search external sources\n- Examples: &#96;ContentAnalysisAgent&#96;, &#96;KnowledgeGraphAssistant&#96;, &#96;LocalRAGAssistant&#96;, &#96;OracleAssistant&#96;, &#96;DisclosureAssistant&#96;\n\n### 3. Orchestration\n*Located in &#96;agents/orchestration/&#96;*\n\n- Coordinate multiple agents to accomplish complex tasks\n- Manage workflows and pipelines\n- Examples: &#96;ContentAnalysisEngine&#96;, &#96;ResearchCrew&#96;\n\n## Research Crew Refactoring\n\nThe &#96;research_crew.py&#96; file defines specialized agents (HA, CE, GV, etc.) inline. We are progressively extracting these into individual modules in the &#96;orchestration/research_crew/specialized/&#96; directory.\n\nProgress:\n- [x] Created directory structure\n- [x] Created &#96;historical_timeline_agent.py&#96; as a template\n- [ ] Extract other agent definitions\n- [ ] Update &#96;crew.py&#96; to use the extracted modules\n\n## Documentation\n\nComprehensive documentation for all agents is available in:\n- &#96;packages/docs/architecture/ExtractionAgents.md&#96;\n- &#96;packages/docs/architecture/AnalysisAgents.md&#96;\n- &#96;packages/docs/architecture/ResearchCrew.md&#96;\n",

        "originalContents": "go install github.com/charmbracelet/glamour@latest\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Note:** The CLI will work without Charm tools but with reduced functionality.\n\n## Configuration\n\nCreate a &#96;.env&#96; file with the following variables:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nOPENAI_API_KEY=your_api_key\nANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your_api_key\nOPENAI_ASSISTANT_ID=your_assistant_id\nOPENAI_VECTOR_STORE_ID=your_vector_store_id\nKNOWLEDGE_BASE_PATH=./knowledge\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n\n# Disclosure RAG - Agent System\n\n## Agent Organization\n\nAgents are organized into three primary categories:\n\n### 1. Extraction Agents \n*Located in &#96;agents/extraction/&#96;*\n\n- Convert raw inputs (text, files, media) into structured artifacts \n- Focus on entity extraction, not reasoning\n- Examples: &#96;EntityExtractionAgent&#96;\n\n### 2. Analysis Agents\n*Located in &#96;agents/analysis/&#96;*\n\n- Perform reasoning, correlation, verification, and visualization\n- Answer questions, build graphs, search external sources\n- Examples: &#96;ContentAnalysisAgent&#96;, &#96;KnowledgeGraphAssistant&#96;, &#96;LocalRAGAssistant&#96;, &#96;OracleAssistant&#96;, &#96;DisclosureAssistant&#96;\n\n### 3. Orchestration\n*Located in &#96;agents/orchestration/&#96;*\n\n- Coordinate multiple agents to accomplish complex tasks\n- Manage workflows and pipelines\n- Examples: &#96;ContentAnalysisEngine&#96;, &#96;ResearchCrew&#96;\n\n## Research Crew Refactoring\n\nThe &#96;research_crew.py&#96; file defines specialized agents (HA, CE, GV, etc.) inline. We are progressively extracting these into individual modules in the &#96;orchestration/research_crew/specialized/&#96; directory.\n\nProgress:\n- [x] Created directory structure\n- [x] Created &#96;historical_timeline_agent.py&#96; as a template\n- [ ] Extract other agent definitions\n- [ ] Update &#96;crew.py&#96; to use the extracted modules\n\n## Documentation\n\nComprehensive documentation for all agents is available in:\n- &#96;packages/docs/architecture/ExtractionAgents.md&#96;\n- &#96;packages/docs/architecture/AnalysisAgents.md&#96;\n- &#96;packages/docs/architecture/ResearchCrew.md&#96;\n",

        "contents": "# CLAUDE.md\n\nThis file provides guidance to Claude when working with code in this repository.\n\n## Project Overview\n\nPrometheus AI is a Next.js research assistant application specialized in UFO/UAP (Unidentified Aerial Phenomena) information. The application provides an interactive AI agent interface with advanced document processing capabilities and immersive visual effects.\n\n### Key Features\n\n- Conversational AI agent with file upload and analysis capabilities\n- Two distinct AI personalities: Prometheus and Daedalus frameworks\n- Document processing tools (summarization, topic extraction, contextualization)\n- Three.js background visualization with custom shader effects\n- Modern UI built with Radix UI and Tailwind CSS\n\n## Development Setup\n\n### Installation \u0026 Commands\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install dependencies\nbun install\n\n# Development server\nbun run dev\n\n# Production build\nbun run build\n\n# Start production server\nbun run start\n\n# Code linting\nbun run lint\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Architecture Overview\n\n### Core Technologies\n\n- **Next.js**: React framework with TypeScript\n- **Anthropic Claude**: AI model integration via AI SDK\n- **React Three Fiber**: 3D visualization and shader effects\n- **Framer Motion**: UI animations and transitions\n- **Tailwind CSS + Radix UI**: Styling and component system\n- **Storybook**: Component development environment\n\n### Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\napp/\n├── api/agent/           # AI agent API endpoints\n├── layout.tsx           # Application layout\n└── page.tsx            # Main landing page\n\ncomponents/\n├── ui/                 # Reusable UI components\n├── agent.tsx           # Main chat interface\n├── CirclesShader.tsx   # Three.js visual effects\n├── document-*.tsx      # Document processing components\n└── error-boundary.tsx  # Error handling\n\nlib/\n├── prometheus.prompts.ts # Prometheus AI framework\n├── daedalus.prompt.ts   # Daedalus AI framework\n└── build-prompt.ts      # Prompt construction utilities\n",

        "contents": "# Agent Guidelines for Ultraterrestrial Resurrection\n\n## Build/Test Commands\n\n- **Dev**: &#96;bun run dev:app&#96; (main app), &#96;cd apps/app \u0026\u0026 bun run dev&#96; (direct)\n- **Build**: &#96;bun run build:app&#96; or &#96;cd apps/app \u0026\u0026 bun run build&#96;\n- **Lint**: &#96;cd apps/app \u0026\u0026 bun run lint&#96; (ESLint + Next.js)\n- **Test**: &#96;cd apps/app \u0026\u0026 bun run test&#96; (single test file)\n- **Storybook**: &#96;bun run storybook&#96; or &#96;cd apps/app \u0026\u0026 bun run storybook&#96;\n\n## Code Style Guidelines\n\n- **Naming**: Directories &#96;kebab-case&#96;, Components &#96;PascalCase&#96;, hooks &#96;camelCase&#96; with &#96;use&#96; prefix, utils &#96;kebab-case&#96; named exports\n- **Imports**: Use &#96;@/&#96; for src paths, &#96;@db/&#96; for database, absolute imports preferred\n- **Components**: Default exports, functional components, Server Components by default, mark Client Components with &#96;\"use client\"&#96;\n- **Types**: TypeScript strict mode disabled, use interfaces for props, prefer type inference\n- **Error Handling**: Try/catch for async functions, user-friendly error messages, proper loading states\n- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS only, component-specific styles in component files, use &#96;cn()&#96; utility for conditional classes\n\n## Architecture Patterns\n\n- **Monorepo**: &#96;apps/app/&#96; (main), &#96;apps/disclosure-rag/&#96; (RAG), &#96;packages/&#96; (shared)\n- **Features**: Self-contained in &#96;src/features/\u003cfeature\u003e/&#96; with &#96;components/&#96;, &#96;hooks/&#96;, &#96;utils/&#96;, &#96;store/&#96;, &#96;actions/&#96;\n- **Services**: External integrations in &#96;src/services/&#96; (AI, processing, knowledge, sightings)\n- **State**: Zustand for global state, React context for feature state, keep state local when possible\n- **Data Fetching**: Server Components for SSR, SWR/React Query for client-side, Xata/Supabase via service layer\n\n## Key Rules from .cursor/rules/\n\n- Use App Router conventions, Server Actions for mutations, proper caching strategies\n- Follow SOLID principles, composition over inheritance, dependency injection patterns\n- Never expose secrets to client, sanitize user input, implement proper auth/authorization\n",

        "contents": "# Ultraterrestrial - Application State Report\n\n**Generated:** January 15, 2025 | **Branch:** feat/code-recovery\n\n---\n\n## Project Overview\n\n**Ultraterrestrial** is a UFO/UAP disclosure tracking platform designed as the definitive hub for exploring the \"state of disclosure\" through data visualization, AI analysis, and collaborative research tools. Currently in active development with substantial progress across multiple domains.\n\n---\n\n## Architecture Summary\n\n### Monorepo Structure\n\n- **apps/app/** - Next.js 15 main application (TypeScript, React 19)\n- **apps/disclosure-rag/** - Python RAG system with specialized AI agents\n- **apps/cli/** - Command-line tools with enhanced Charm UI\n- **packages/** - Shared libraries (db, ai, knowledge-base, docs, services)\n\n### Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend:** Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui\n- **3D Graphics:** Three.js, React Three Fiber, GSAP\n- **Database:** Xata (primary), Supabase (migration target)\n- **AI:** OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5, custom agent framework\n- **Tools:** Bun, Cursor IDE, comprehensive linting\n\n---\n\n## Implementation Status\n\n### ✅ Fully Implemented\n\n**1. AI Agent System (Production Ready)**\n\n- 11 specialized research agents with distinct roles\n- Centralized prompt management system\n- Multi-provider LLM integration (OpenAI + Anthropic)\n- Entity extraction and relationship mapping\n- Advanced chat interfaces with knowledge base access\n\n**2. Database Layer (Complete)**\n\n- Comprehensive schema: sightings, personnel, events, topics, organizations, testimonies, documents, artifacts\n- Multi-provider registry (Xata active, Supabase ready)\n- Optimized server actions and data operations\n- Migration documentation and utilities\n\n**3. Mind Map/Network Graph (Production Ready)**\n\n- XyFlow-based interactive visualization\n- Dynamic entity relationship mapping\n- Custom node types for different categories\n- Search, filter, and exploration capabilities\n\n**4. Document Processing Pipeline (Functional)**\n\n",

        "contents": "import json\nimport logging\nimport os\nfrom typing import Dict, Any, Optional, List, Union\nimport time\n\nfrom agno.agent import Agent\nfrom agno.models.anthropic import Claude as AnthropicChat\nfrom agno.models.openai import OpenAIChat\nfrom agno.storage.sqlite import SqliteStorage\nfrom openai import OpenAI\n\n# Import research prompt \nfrom research.research_prompt import research_prompt\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\nlogging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)\n\nclass ContentAnalysisAgent:\n    \"\"\"\n    Agent for analyzing content using structured research methodology.\n    Supports multiple LLM providers for comprehensive analysis.\n    \"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, storage_path=\"tmp/content_analysis.db\", vector_store_id=None):\n        \"\"\"\n        Initialize the ContentAnalysisAgent with multiple LLM providers.\n        \n        Args:\n            storage_path: Path to SQLite storage for conversation history\n            vector_store_id: Optional ID of vector store for file search\n        \"\"\"\n        self.claude_model = AnthropicChat(id=\"claude-3-5-sonnet\")\n        self.openai_model = OpenAIChat(id=\"gpt-4o\")\n        self.storage_path = storage_path\n        self.vector_store_id = vector_store_id\n        \n        # Initialize OpenAI client for Assistants API\n        self.openai_client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get(\"OPENAI_API_KEY\"))\n        \n        # Get Assistant ID from environment variable or create a new assistant\n        self.assistant_id = os.environ.get(\"DISCLOSURE_ASSISTANT_ID\")\n        if not self.assistant_id:\n            logger.warning(\"DISCLOSURE_ASSISTANT_ID not found. Creating a new assistant.\")\n            self.assistant_id = self._create_assistant()\n        \n        # Initialize traditional agents\n        self.claude_agent = self._create_claude_agent()\n        self.openai_agent = self._create_openai_agent()",

        "originalContents": "import json\nimport logging\nimport os\nfrom typing import Dict, Any, Optional, List, Union\nimport time\n\nfrom agno.agent import Agent\nfrom agno.models.anthropic import Claude as AnthropicChat\nfrom agno.models.openai import OpenAIChat\nfrom agno.storage.sqlite import SqliteStorage\nfrom openai import OpenAI\n\n# Import research prompt \nfrom research.research_prompt import research_prompt\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\nlogging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)\n\nclass ContentAnalysisAgent:\n    \"\"\"\n    Agent for analyzing content using structured research methodology.\n    Supports multiple LLM providers for comprehensive analysis.\n    \"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, storage_path=\"tmp/content_analysis.db\", vector_store_id=None):\n        \"\"\"\n        Initialize the ContentAnalysisAgent with multiple LLM providers.\n        \n        Args:\n            storage_path: Path to SQLite storage for conversation history\n            vector_store_id: Optional ID of vector store for file search\n        \"\"\"\n        self.claude_model = AnthropicChat(id=\"claude-3-5-sonnet\")\n        self.openai_model = OpenAIChat(id=\"gpt-4o\")\n        self.storage_path = storage_path\n        self.vector_store_id = vector_store_id\n        \n        # Initialize OpenAI client for Assistants API\n        self.openai_client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get(\"OPENAI_API_KEY\"))\n        \n        # Get Assistant ID from environment variable or create a new assistant\n        self.assistant_id = os.environ.get(\"DISCLOSURE_ASSISTANT_ID\")\n        if not self.assistant_id:\n            logger.warning(\"DISCLOSURE_ASSISTANT_ID not found. Based on my search through the `apps/app` workspace, here's what I found regarding Claude agents:

## Claude Agent Implementation Status in `apps/app`

### ✅ **Existing Claude Integration**

1. **Basic Claude Client Setup** (`apps/app/src/services/ai/claude/`)
   - `get-claude-response.ts` - Core Claude API integration functions
   - `index.ts` - Anthropic SDK client initialization
   - Functions include:
     - `getClaudeTextResponse()` - Basic text generation
     - `getClaudeSummary()` - Content summarization
     - `streamClaudeResponse()` - Streaming responses
     - `getClaudeVisualization()` - Visualization-specific responses

2. **Agent Execution Pipeline** (`apps/app/src/features/ai/pipelines/agent-execution-pipeline/`)
   - Complete agent testing environment with dual-panel interface
   - Supports multiple agent patterns (sequential, routing, parallel, orchestrator, evaluator)
   - Real-time agent execution with parameter customization
   - Mobile-responsive design with output visualization

3. **Agent Types Defined** (`apps/app/src/features/ai/pipelines/types.ts`)
   - **Sequential Processing Agent** - Multi-stage content transformation
   - **Routing Agent** - Intelligent query routing to specialized agents
   - **Parallel Agent** - Concurrent processing capabilities
   - **Orchestrator Agent** - Multi-agent coordination
   - **Evaluator Agent** - Quality assessment and validation

### 🔧 **Agent Infrastructure**

4. **Admin Interface** (`apps/app/src/app/(auth)/admin/agents/`)
   - Agent management pages
   - Web processing pipeline integration
   - Extraction agent interface

5. **Workflow Integration** (`apps/app/src/services/ai/workflows/`)
   - `prompt-to-multistep.workflow.ts` - Multi-step agent workflows
   - Integration with OpenAI Assistants API for complex agent orchestration

### 📋 **Agent Capabilities**

The existing agent system includes:
- **Multi-model support** (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4, etc.)
- **Streaming responses** for real-time interaction
- **Tool integration** (file search, database queries, ReactFlow transformation)
- **Parameter customization** (temperature, max tokens, etc.)
- **Progress tracking** and token usage monitoring
- **Mobile-responsive interfaces**

### �� **What's NOT Found**

- No dedicated "Claude agents" as separate, specialized agents
- No agent-specific Claude implementations beyond the basic client
- No workspace-specific Claude agent configurations (like those found in `apps/disclosure-rag/`)

### �� **Summary**

The `apps/app` workspace has a **sophisticated agent execution framework** that can use Claude as one of the available AI models, but it doesn't have dedicated "Claude agents" in the same way that `apps/disclosure-rag/` has specialized research agents. The system is designed to be model-agnostic, allowing any agent type to use Claude, GPT, or other models based on configuration.

The agent system is production-ready and includes comprehensive UI components, but the actual agent implementations are more generic/framework-based rather than Claude-specific specialized agents.
